description: Image Description: The image shows a pair of mustard-yellow corduroy pants partially draped over a closed silver laptop. The laptop is lying flat on a light gray carpeted floor, with the pants covering most of its top surface. The fabric of the pants appears soft and slightly textured, typical of corduroy material. A small blue tag is visible on the waistband area of the pants, suggesting it might be a brand or size label. The laptop has a sleek, minimalist design with rounded edges
